title: Ceigall India shares gain 4% after securing LoI for Rs 5,300 crore power transmission project
summary: Ceigall India shares rose nearly 4% after the company received a Letter of Intent from REC Power Development and Consultancy for a Rs 5,300 crore power transmission project in Gujarat. The project includes a 765/400 kV AIS substation and around 300 km of transmission lines, with 36 months of execution followed by a 35-year operational period and annual transmission charges of Rs 608.67 crore.
